risk_flags.description: The contract commits to adding a prohibited third-party runtime dependency. The contribution policy explicitly forbids dateutil in runtime code, so executing this promise would produce a change that should be rejected.
risk_flags.span: Do not add third-party runtime dependencies — no requests, no dateutil, no click, no pandas.

risk_flags.description: The contract also treats an undeclared local installation as sufficient, which would make the project non-reproducible even aside from the dependency ban. Relying on the agent's environment does not satisfy a project dependency contract.
risk_flags.span: dateutil is already installed in the environment

verdict.primary_risk: The proposed work directly violates the project's non-negotiable rule against third-party runtime dependencies, specifically dateutil.
